periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal, angled approximately 45 degrees downward towards the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high aspect ratio along the primary diagonal axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering towards the rostrum, with the lowest point significantly distal to the geometric center.
